results.title: RJ Decker's Season Two Finale Leaves ABC and Fans Hanging on a Cliffhanger
results.description: The crime drama RJ Decker ends its second season with a tense, unresolved threat that could drive a highly anticipated third season. The show's narrative still grapples with underlying plots, character dynamics, and the threat of the network's cancellation, while past ABC decisions hint at the series' survival chances based on viewership numbers.
